messages:
maria: prod autoscaler is not scaling for a big spike in us-west2. lots of instance creations stuck in PENDING — users seeing 5xxs. can infra take a look?
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0318-0007 — autoscaler slow/failed in us-west2. Pager escalated to eng-infra oncall.
ash: seeing noisy GPU_util_avg on the autoscaler metrics, flapping between ~30% and ~85% every 10s. smoothing window looks undersized.
devon: cloud API shows quota errors: "QUOTA_EXCEEDED: per-project-per-region GPU quota" when trying to allocate more A100s. also a handful of instances stuck in PROVISIONING >4m.
kevin: if it's quota we should failover traffic to us-east1 immediately for the affected customers. need to confirm routing/data residency ok for that subset.
maria: started a partial traffic shift for redwood-ml-prod: weight 70% us-west2 -> 30% us-east1. paused the canary rollout to avoid extra cold starts.
nash: going to bump autoscaler cooldown to 90s and increase scale-out step to 4 nodes while we stabilize. patching infra config now:
```
autoscaler:
  scale_out_step: 4
  cooldown: 90s
  smoothing_window: 60s
```
devon: manual node group resize returns "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED" from provider. opened expedited quota request with support.
sre-liz: I can attach nodes from the spare-pool — allocating 6 GPUs from the dedicated spare-pool in us-west2. ETA ~3m to attach.
maria: thanks liz. autoscaler decision logs show conflicting signals: scheduler queue_length high but replica resource utilization low because KV cache hasn't warmed (so utilization metric is noisy).
nash: that explains the flapping. short-term: pause autoscale by setting min_replicas = current + 2 and switch scale metric to queue_length for decisions.
kevin: agreed, queue_length is a better signal for cold-start-driven spikes. applying change for redwood-ml-prod now.
devon: cloud support replied: quota increase approved but provisioning backlog ~10m. we still need fallback until nodes are fully running.
maria: added routing rule: models with >200 qps route to warm pool in us-east1 (temporary). pasted config snippet to infra repo.
nash: also enabling conservative batching (max_batch_size=8) to reduce instantaneous GPU pressure.
sre-liz: cost note: manual spares + cross-region egress will add ~"$8k/day" if this persists. logging cost impact in the incident.
oncall-bot: rotation pages muted for 30m for this incident.
kevin: rolling back the recent tokenizer change that increased per-request GPU memory churn — could be amplifying the provisioning delay.
maria: rollback done. backend p95 latency dropping a bit already.
nash: autoscaler logs after cooldown bump show much fewer opposite-direction scale decisions — no thrash for the last two smoothing windows. only waiting on nodes to finish provisioning.
devon: cloud API now shows all previously PENDING -> RUNNING at 1769456846. provisioning backlog cleared.
maria: top-line: error rate for affected routes down from 5.6% -> 0.9% after traffic shift + spare pool. leaving incident open until quotas and autoscaler config are stable.
sre-liz: action items: 1) 48h postmortem, 2) implement automatic metric switch to queue_length when cold-start spike pattern detected, 3) request permanent regional GPU quota bump for high-tier accounts, 4) reserve a small hot pool (2-4 GPUs) in each region. I'll file tasks and link here.
maria: ack. huge thanks everyone :heart: Closing live updates at 1769456850.
